d:
Ever dreamed of staying in a fairytale house in Italy? In this video, we take you inside our traditional Trullo home stay in Alberobello, the magical UNESCO town in Puglia, Southern Italy.
We’ll show you:
A Trullo home tour (the unique cone-roof houses Alberobello is famous for)
Wandering through charming alleys & hidden corners of Alberobello
Delicious Puglian dinner & local food experience
Shopping in Alberobello – from souvenirs to authentic local finds
